sources.title: The New York Times article on Dianna Russini includes new comments from her
sources.description: Dianna Russini had said nothing since abruptly resigning from The Athletic in April, one week after photos first surfaced of Russini and Patriots coach Mike Vrabel at a resort in Sedona, Arizona.
